notes: No Korean-language animal poison line found (only human poison lines / US services; none used). No duty rota usable: KVMA (kvma.or.kr) search surfaced only association pages with no on-duty list; animal.go.kr 24-hour hospital list and Jungnang-gu holiday-clinic xlsx were disallowed by robots.txt and not used. Blocked by robots.txt / not fetched: Kyungpook (vmc.knu.ac.kr), Jeju National Univ. (vethospital.jejunu.ac.kr), Chungnam (cnuah.cnu.ac.kr), Chungbuk Cheongju (vetmed.chungbuk.ac.kr), Gyeongsang (gamc.gnu.ac.kr), Time AMC Daejeon (timeamc.com), Bless AMC (blessamc.com), Instagram pages. Sites that loop on http/https redirects and could not be read: cenamc.kr (24시센트럴), wooridleclinic.kr (24시우리들), gonggam24.kr (Gwangju), nowamc.co.kr, yeamc.com, vamc.co.kr, theboneamc.com, 24samc.co.kr main page; bonamc.co.kr returned a client error. Gwangju Noa 24 AMC seen only on an aggregator (ban-life.com) so skipped. Gangwon University hospital page and Gyeonggi/city vet association rotas not found. Regular (non-24h) small-animal clinics in Daejeon, Incheon, Ulsan, Seoul not covered. 2026-11-10 follow-up: added Gwangju Noa 24 (own site), N Nowon, five VIP Seoul branches, Worldpet Yangcheon, Seoul Yes (Yongin), My AMC (Paju). Not used: Seoul city '우리동네동물병원' list and Gwangjin-gu list (KOGL type 4 no-commercial-use / unclear reuse terms); N Gangbuk branch (conflicting addresses on page); bpanimal.com (24시부평, Incheon) and 24samc.co.kr/main.html redirect loop twice; timeamc.com robots-blocked; wooridleclinic.kr redirect loop. Incheon, Daejeon, Ulsan and Jeju regular clinics still not covered: only aggregators (goodoc, fitpet etc.) surfaced for them and own sites could not be found via search (24시도안 Daejeon, 24시 SKY Gwangju, Point Incheon seen only on aggregators/news). 2026-11-10 follow-up 2: added 13 regular clinics (Incheon 5, Daejeon 1, Ulsan 2, Jeju 5), none new 24 h except Songdo OK and Yeonsu AMC (Incheon). No duty rota or animal poison line found. Not used: Incheon open-data list (data.go.kr 15103087, KOGL type 1) has only name and address, no phone/hours; Incheon city animal-welfare pages list no clinics. Unreachable twice (http/https 302 loop): kiwamc.co.kr (Ulsan), i-boneamc.com (Jeju), pointamc.com (Incheon), raphaelah.com, soraeah.co.kr, ysteunteun.ad-media.kr, ilovepet.kr (Daejeon), thenaeun75.dothome.co.kr, littlezoo.com, 포유동물메디컬센터 site (Jeju). robots-blocked: soopamc.com (Daejeon), m.timeamc.com (Daejeon), skyamg.com location page, icheartclinic.co.kr; ic.skyamg.com (Incheon Sky) is JS-only with no readable data. Seen only on aggregators or a third-party page so skipped: Ulsan 24 Smart (dogspring wixsite), Gangil-ung (Ulsan). Daejeon and Ulsan remain thin; Chungnam univ. hospital (Daejeon) robots-blocked.
